newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing to open new underground rail line in 1999.
newsitem.headline: Beijing to open new underground rail line in 1999.

text.p: China's capital expects an extension of its underground rail system to be operational at the end of September 1999, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Tuesday.
The Underground Construction General Corp, which is undertaking the project, will make a decision on the design by the end of this month, the newspaper said.
Construction should be completed by the end of 1998.
"The new underground line would extend from Fuxingmen in the west to Bawanfen in the east running under Changan (Eternal Peace) Avenue," an official from the construction company said.
Company officials declined to estimate the cost of the new line or give other details.
